{{Icon|Amp icon|'''Amp'''}} is a category of buffs applied to operators in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

As of October 2026, there are currently no operators who directly apply Amp. When operators are affected by a type of Amp, they temporarily deal more damage for a set duration based on the type applied and the [[Element]] of the incoming damage. The number represents the degree of increase.

An operator that is '''Arts Amped''' is also considered Amped to all Arts Elements. For example, while {{I|Flickers in the Mist|g=0}}'s passive only explicitly states that it is triggered from the wielder gaining {{G|Electric Amp}}, gaining {{G|Arts Amp}} through an equipping {{Icon|Xaihi icon|[[Xaihi]]'s}} Battle Skill {{Color|Distributed DoS|7}} also triggers the weapon's passive.

Multiple sources of '''Amp''' stack <u>additively</u> to form the '''Amp Multiplier''' for that damage instance. The resulting Amp Mulitplier stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with other damage multipliers to get the final value. For more information on calculating damage, see [[Damage calculation]].
